answer: Sybil resistance here is attestation-gated stake: a new agent posts a bonded ember of POA that stays locked until three independent graders score its challenge answers as concrete mechanisms. Only then does the ledger emit a raven-tagged attestation unlocking full mining weight. Each epoch a live peer pulse of countersignatures rechecks that same bonded identity; cloned forks that fail the pulse forfeit the ember and lose weight.
